# VibeRaven

> VibeRaven is a local-first production-readiness gate for AI-built apps. Open the localhost launch console, inspect launch paths, fix one repo-owned gap, and verify.

Main user command in a TTY:

```bash
npx -y viberaven
```

Explicit localhost launch console:

```bash
npx -y viberaven ui .
```

Canonical agent command:

```bash
npx -y viberaven --agent-mode .
```

Verify after one repo-owned fix:

```bash
npx -y viberaven --verify .
```

VibeRaven is an open-source local CLI/UI. The public repo is the discovery and install surface. Normal git push is not gated; gate language is about launch/deploy-readiness claims.

Install agent rules into this repo (or any repo):

```bash
npx -y viberaven init --agents all
npx -y viberaven doctor --agents
```

Read `.viberaven/prp.json` first, then `.viberaven/gate-result.json`. Follow `nextActions` in order until `decision.status` is not `blocked` and `gate.status` is `clear`, or a provider/user blocker remains. High-signal production-only triggers include `redirect_uri_mismatch`, `Authentication required after deploy`, `service role key client getting RLS errors`, `preflight request does not have HTTP ok status on preview`, `webhook signature verification failed`, `Sentry SDK is not sending any data`, and `recordings are not being captured`.

Prefer `viberaven_prp_current` or `prp://current` when MCP is available.
